# Source: focus_trees/NAM/main/focuses.txt
# Native layout: shared focus history; tools read the authored focus tree.

focus_tree = {
	id = NAM_focus
	country = {
		factor = 0
		modifier = {
			add = 30
			tag = NAM
		}
	}
	default = no
	continuous_focus_position = {
		x = 5000
		y = 5555
	}

	# The generator emits this tree as shared focuses, so the completed pre-war
	# course stays readable after the victory or compromise tree is loaded.

	shared_focus = NAM_inventory

	# ----- Colony: trade with the metropole and the underground -----
	# The only course visible before the collapse of Vorkerland. The trade, watch
	# and hourglass routes together take longer than the window before the centre
	# vanishes, so the player chooses which colony focuses to finish. The colony
	# decisions close with the collapse wars, so the same moment bypasses
	# whatever is left of the colony; NAM_center_vanished (event
	# ADISCORD_nam_resource_war.80) reveals the other branches, which carry
	# allow_branch on their roots.

	# ----- Colony: the metropole's hourglass -----
	# The centre's emergency commissioner demands deliveries now. Serving the plan
	# trades fuel for metropolitan arms; the second ledger hides the centre's
	# share for independence. Bypass completes a focus without its reward, so the
	# delayed rewards read variables and flags written by the rewards themselves,
	# never has_completed_focus.

	# ----- Independence -----
	# Opens with the collapse; the posture towards the restitution claim
	# follows the declaration.

	# ----- Administration and the ladder of seals -----

	# ----- Pillars of power and their rivals -----

	# ----- Incident office -----

	# ----- Underground of the oil belt -----
	# The districts negotiate with Weber's network; the vertical hunts its caches.

	# ----- Oil economy -----
	# The export and refining courses open different field projects; contracts
	# and the shared projects follow the register.

	# ----- Garrisons, mobilisation orders and defence lines -----

	# ----- Air service -----

	# ----- Harbour and the islands -----

	# ----- Restitution diplomacy -----
	# Available while the restitution clock runs; skipped once the war starts.

	# ----- Resource war: visible after the gateway, available during the war -----

	shared_focus = NAM_alarm

}

		icon = GFX_focus_generic_currency_reforms
		x = 1
		y = 12
		cost = 2
		search_filters = { FOCUS_FILTER_INDUSTRY }
		prerequisite = {
			focus = NAM_emergency_writ
			focus = NAM_district_guarantees
		}
		available = {
			has_capitulated = no
		}
		cancel_if_invalid = yes
		continue_if_invalid = no
		completion_reward = {
			effect_tooltip = {
				swap_ideas = {
					remove_idea = NAM_administration_dummy_idea
					add_idea = NAM_adm_one_budget_idea
				}
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				add_to_variable = { var = NAM_adm_admin_expense value = -0.02 }
				NAM_refresh_administration = yes
			}
			ADISCORD_reform_society_development = yes
			custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_receive_250_tt
			hidden_effect = { NAM_receive_250 = yes }
			unlock_decision_tooltip = NAM_oil_bonds
			custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_oil_bonds_unlock_tt
			unlock_decision_tooltip = NAM_emergency_decrees
			custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_emergency_decrees_unlock_tt
		}
		ai_will_do = {
			base = 5
		}
	}
